caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, primarily brown in color. The chest has eight visible drawers arranged vertically in two sections: a top section with five drawers and a larger bottom section with three drawers. Each drawer is fitted with two brass handles shaped like bat wings. The uppermost portion features an ornate, curved pediment with two finials and a central urn finial, as well as a shell-like carved motif on the central upper drawer. Fluted pilasters adorn the sides of the upper section, and the chest stands on bracket feet. The wood grain is visible, and the overall shape is rectangular with decorative, classical elements at the top. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Chest-On-Chest
